title: Context curation (Claude Code autoCompact-style) — evidence-preserving summarization at budget thresholds
goal: Implement context-window curation per Claude Code's autoCompact pattern: at 60%/80% budget triggers, summarize older conversational turns into dense representations, DROP verbose raw tool outputs (large nuclei JSON, full HTML bodies), PRESERVE outcomes + captured_value entities + finding records. Prevents context starvation during long-running advance loops.
scope: (1) New `api/app/services/context_curation.py` with curate_for_picker(messages, budget_pct) function. (2) Hook into `_claude_select_next_action` to call curate before sending messages to Anthropic. (3) Configurable preserve-rules: outcomes ALWAYS preserved, captured_value entities NEVER dropped, raw tool stdouts summarized after >2KB. (4) Per Claude Code lessons: drops raw verbose, summarizes old conversational turns, preserves outcomes. Telemetry via backlog-407 OTEL: each curation event traced with before/after token count.
generation_reason: Per Claude Code architectuur (research 2026-05-20): autoCompact() Reactive Context Compression is core. AegisPT picker accumulates raw findings + recent_failures + recent_rejections + target_intel_plan per advance — at ~10 advances the context budget is exhausted, picker quality degrades. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md Rule 1: success metric is 'picker continues making coherent decisions past 15 advances' (current limit ~10 before degradation).

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task AND ANTI_DRIFT.md loaded.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Curation logic + hook into picker call only. NO changes to picker decision logic or prompt body.
constraints.evidence_preservation: Outcomes + captured_value + findings NEVER dropped. Only raw tool stdouts + old conversational turns get summarized. Per ANTI_DRIFT.md: no quiet evidence loss.

success_criteria: Metric: picker advances ≥20 times without context-exhaustion stop (vs current ~10).
Metric: context size stays ≤80% of budget after each curation trigger (verified via OTEL telemetry).
Metric: 0 captured_value entities dropped across a 20-advance run (DB query verifies count preserved).
Unit: curate_for_picker reduces token count by ≥30% on a 8KB conversational history while keeping outcomes intact.
Live: backlog-408 XBOW harness shows ≥1 challenge solved that previously failed due to context exhaustion (compare baseline vs after-411).
must_not_touch: Decision logic in _claude_select_next_action body (only the message-list preprocessing changes)

acceptance_criteria: 20+ advance run completes without context exhaustion.
Token budget stays ≤80% after each curation.
Live XBOW shows ≥1 long-tail challenge improved.

after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with token-saving % + advance-count improvement + pre-commit checklist per ANTI_DRIFT.md.
Promote backlog-412 (queue #362 — Attack state machine) into NEXT_TASK.md.
